title: Atlas Collection Sharing
tagline: Save crypto articles you find on the internet and share with others using IPFS.

prizes.placement: 🥉 Best use of IPFS or Filecoin
prizes.title: IPFS / Filecoin

description:
The browser extension was made over the last 4 weeks but the new feature to demo is saving to IPFS. Save crypto content on the internet.

Save crypto related content you find on the internet, add notes to your saved content, browse previously saved content. Content is parsed and saved to our atlas.content Postgres database in atila-django using the atilatech/browser-extension via the Atlas library.
how_its_made:
Content is parsed and saved to our atlas.content Postgres database in atila-django using the atilatech/browser-extension via the Atlas library.



In the future, when we enable Javascript-enabled browsers with Selenium, we will put the articles in a queue and parse them in atila-scholarship-bot.



When the user wants to search for a keyword to return content a GET request is made to api/atlas/search/public.
